segments.an11.13:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sakkesu viharati kapilavatthusmiṃ nigrodhārāme.
segments.an11.13:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ vassāvāsaṃ upagantukāmo hoti [ahosi (ka.)].
segments.an11.13:2.5: Tattha kammantañceva adhiṭṭhahissāmi, bhagavantañca lacchāmi kālena kālaṃ dassanāyā”ti.
segments.an11.13:3.1: Atha kho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ vassāvāsaṃ upagacchi [upagañchi (sī. pī.)].
segments.an11.13:3.2: Nandiyopi kho sakko sāvatthiyaṃ vassāvāsaṃ upagacchi.
segments.an11.13:3.3: Tattha kammantañceva adhiṭṭhāsi [adhiṭṭhāya (syā.), adhiṭṭhāti (ka.)], bhagavantañca labhi [lacchati (syā. ka.)] kālena kālaṃ dassanāya.
segments.an11.13:3.4: Tena kho pana samayena sambahulā bhikkhū bhagavato cīvarakammaṃ karonti –
segments.an11.13:4.4: Atha kho nandiyo sakko yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho nandiyo sakko bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.an11.13:4.6: ‘sambahulā kira bhikkhū bhagavato cīvarakammaṃ karonti – niṭṭhitacīvaro bhagavā temāsaccayena cārikaṃ pakkamissatī’ti.
segments.an11.13:4.8: Tesaṃ no, bhante, nānāvihārehi viharataṃ kenassa vihārena vihātabban”ti?
segments.an11.13:5.2: Etaṃ kho, nandiya, tumhākaṃ patirūpaṃ kulaputtānaṃ, yaṃ tumhe tathāgataṃ upasaṅkamitvā puccheyyātha –
segments.an11.13:5.3: ‘tesaṃ no, bhante, nānāvihārehi viharataṃ kenassa vihārena vihātabban’ti?
segments.an11.13:5.4: Saddho kho, nandiya, ārādhako hoti, no assaddho;
segments.an11.13:5.10: Imesu kho te, nandiya, chasu dhammesu patiṭṭhāya pañcasu dhammesu ajjhattaṃ sati upaṭṭhāpetabbā.
segments.an11.13:6.2: ‘itipi so bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi, satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā’ti.
segments.an11.13:6.3: Iti kho te, nandiya, tathāgataṃ ārabbha ajjhattaṃ sati upaṭṭhāpetabbā.
segments.an11.13:7.2: ‘svākkhāto bhagavatā dhammo sandiṭṭhiko akāliko ehipassiko opaneyyiko paccattaṃ veditabbo viññūhī’ti.
segments.an11.13:7.3: Iti kho te, nandiya, dhammaṃ ārabbha ajjhattaṃ sati upaṭṭhāpetabbā.
segments.an11.13:8.2: ‘lābhā vata me, suladdhaṃ vata me, yassa me kalyāṇamittā anukampakā atthakāmā ovādakā anusāsakā’ti.
segments.an11.13:8.4: Iti kho te, nandiya, kalyāṇamitte ārabbha ajjhattaṃ sati upaṭṭhāpetabbā.
segments.an11.13:9.1: “Puna caparaṃ tvaṃ, nandiya, attano cāgaṃ anussareyyāsi –
segments.an11.13:9.2: ‘lābhā vata me, suladdhaṃ vata me, yohaṃ maccheramalapariyuṭṭhitāya pajāya vigatamalamaccherena cetasā agāraṃ ajjhāvasāmi muttacāgo payatapāṇi vossaggarato yācayogo dānasaṃvibhāgarato’ti.
segments.an11.13:9.4: Iti kho te, nandiya, cāgaṃ ārabbha ajjhattaṃ sati upaṭṭhāpetabbā.
segments.an11.13:10.2: ‘yā devatā atikkammeva kabaḷīkārāhārabhakkhānaṃ [kabaḷiṃkārabhakkhānaṃ (sī.), kabaḷīkārabhakkhānaṃ (syā. kaṃ. pī.)] devatānaṃ sahabyataṃ aññataraṃ manomayaṃ kāyaṃ upapannā, tā karaṇīyaṃ attano na samanupassanti katassa vā paticayaṃ.
segments.an11.13:10.3: Seyyathāpi, nandiya, bhikkhu asamayavimutto karaṇīyaṃ attano na samanupassati katassa vā paticayaṃ;
segments.an11.13:10.4: evamevaṃ kho, nandiya, yā tā devatā atikkammeva kabaḷīkārāhārabhakkhānaṃ devatānaṃ sahabyataṃ aññataraṃ manomayaṃ kāyaṃ upapannā, tā karaṇīyaṃ attano na samanupassanti katassa vā paticayaṃ.
segments.an11.13:10.5: Iti kho te, nandiya, devatā ārabbha ajjhattaṃ sati upaṭṭhāpetabbā.
segments.an11.13:11.1: “Imehi kho, nandiya, ekādasahi dhammehi samannāgato ariyasāvako pajahateva pāpake akusale dhamme, na upādiyati.
segments.an11.13:11.2: Seyyathāpi, nandiya, kumbho nikkujjo [nikujjo (ka.)] vamateva udakaṃ, no vantaṃ paccāvamati [paccāmasati (syā.)];
segments.an11.13:11.3: seyyathāpi vā pana, nandiya, sukkhe tiṇadāye aggi mutto ḍahaññeva gacchati, no daḍḍhaṃ paccudāvattati;
segments.an11.13:11.4: evamevaṃ kho, nandiya, imehi ekādasahi dhammehi samannāgato ariyasāvako pajahateva pāpake akusale dhamme, na upādiyatī”ti.

lines: Ko pana devānaṃ āhāro, kā āhāravelāti?
Sā heṭṭhimehi heṭṭhimehi uparimānaṃ uparimānaṃ paṇītatamā hoti, taṃ yathāsakaṃ divasavaseneva divase divase bhuñjanti.
Keci pana “biḷārapadappamāṇaṃ sudhāhāraṃ bhuñjanti, so jivhāya ṭhapitamatto yāva kesagganakhaggā kāyaṃ pharati, tesaṃyeva divasavasena satta divase yāpanasamattho hotī”ti vadanti.
Aṭṭhannañhi samāpattīnaṃ samāpajjanassa samayopi atthi tassa asamayopi, maggavimokkhena pana vimuccanassa samayo vā asamayo vā natthi.
Yassa saddhā balavatī, vipassanā ca āraddhā, tassa gacchantassa tiṭṭhantassa nisīdantassa nipajjantassa khādantassa bhuñjantassa ca maggaphalappaṭivedho nāma na hotīti na vattabbaṃ.
Iti maggavimokkhena vimuccantassa samayo vā asamayo vā natthīti maggavimokkho asamayavimutti nāma.
